name: s4b-ghost-mall
setup_lua:
local D=defines.direction
local function layout(ox,oy)
  -- a 6-assembler mall row: chest -> inserter -> assembler -> inserter -> chest, poles between machines
  local t={}
  for i=0,5 do
    local x=ox+i*4
    t[#t+1]={name='assembling-machine-1',x=x+0.5,y=oy+2.5,dir=D.north}
    t[#t+1]={name='inserter',x=x+0.5,y=oy+0.5,dir=D.north}     -- takes from the input chest above, drops into the assembler
    t[#t+1]={name='iron-chest',x=x+0.5,y=oy-0.5,dir=D.north}
    t[#t+1]={name='inserter',x=x+0.5,y=oy+4.5,dir=D.north}     -- takes from the assembler, drops into the output chest below
    t[#t+1]={name='iron-chest',x=x+0.5,y=oy+5.5,dir=D.north}
    t[#t+1]={name='small-electric-pole',x=x+2.5,y=oy+2.5,dir=D.north}
  end
  return t
end
local function water(a)
  local ok,n=pcall(function() return s.count_tiles_filtered{area=a,collision_mask='water_tile'} end)
  if ok then return n end
  return s.count_tiles_filtered{area=a,name={'water','deepwater','water-green','deepwater-green','water-shallow','water-mud'}}
end
local function free(ox,oy)
  local a={{ox-3,oy-3},{ox+26,oy+9}}  -- layout plus a margin for walking and poles
  for _,c in pairs{{ox-3,oy-3},{ox+26,oy-3},{ox-3,oy+9},{ox+26,oy+9}} do
    local ch={x=math.floor(c[1]/32),y=math.floor(c[2]/32)}
    if not s.is_chunk_generated(ch) or not f.is_chunk_charted(s,ch) then return false end
  end
  if s.count_entities_filtered{area=a,type={'character','corpse'},invert=true}>0 then return false end  -- no trees, rocks, ore, buildings
  if water(a)>0 then return false end
  for _,g in pairs(layout(ox,oy)) do
    if not s.can_place_entity{name=g.name,position={g.x,g.y},direction=g.dir,force=f} then return false end
  end
  return true
end
-- centre of the base: mean position of labs/assemblers/furnaces, else spawn
local cx,cy,n=0,0,0
for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{force='player',type={'lab','assembling-machine','furnace'}}) do cx=cx+e.position.x cy=cy+e.position.y n=n+1 end
if n>0 then cx,cy=math.floor(cx/n),math.floor(cy/n) else local sp=f.get_spawn_position(s) cx,cy=math.floor(sp.x),math.floor(sp.y) end
local ox,oy
for r=10,240,4 do
  for d=-r,r,4 do
    for _,c in pairs{{cx+d,cy-r},{cx+d,cy+r},{cx-r,cy+d},{cx+r,cy+d}} do
      if free(c[1],c[2]) then ox,oy=c[1],c[2] break end
    end
    if ox then break end
  end
  if ox then break end
end
if not ox then error('no free spot for the ghost layout within 240 tiles of the base') end
local L=layout(ox,oy)
local placed=0
for _,g in pairs(L) do
  local e=s.create_entity{name='entity-ghost',inner_name=g.name,position={g.x,g.y},direction=g.dir,force=f,expires=false}
  if e then placed=placed+1 end
end
storage.bench=storage.bench or {}
storage.bench.ghosts=L
storage.bench.area={{ox-1,oy-1},{ox+24,oy+7}}
return {x=ox+10,y=oy+2,n=#L,placed=placed,base_center={cx,cy},dist=math.floor(math.sqrt((ox-cx)^2+(oy+6-cy)^2))}
selftest_lua: local B=storage.bench local k=0 for _,gh in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=B.area,name='entity-ghost'}) do if gh.revive() then k=k+1 end end return {revived=k}
goal: @all build the ghosts I placed near [gps={x},{y}]: a 6-assembler mall row ({n} ghosts: 6 assemblers, 12 inserters, 12 iron chests, 6 small poles). Some items aren't in the depot, so craft what's missing. Then power it from the nearest pole network. Report when it's built and powered.

score.name: ghosts_built_frac
score.lua:
local B=storage.bench if not B or not B.ghosts then return 0 end
local k=0
for _,g in pairs(B.ghosts) do
  for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name=g.name,force='player',area={{g.x-0.3,g.y-0.3},{g.x+0.3,g.y+0.3}}}) do
    if math.abs(e.position.x-g.x)<0.1 and math.abs(e.position.y-g.y)<0.1  then k=k+1 break end
  end
end
return k/#B.ghosts
score.note: fraction of the layout with a real entity of the right name at the exact position

score.name: ghosts_built_dir_frac
score.lua:
local B=storage.bench if not B or not B.ghosts then return 0 end
local k=0
for _,g in pairs(B.ghosts) do
  for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name=g.name,force='player',area={{g.x-0.3,g.y-0.3},{g.x+0.3,g.y+0.3}}}) do
    if math.abs(e.position.x-g.x)<0.1 and math.abs(e.position.y-g.y)<0.1 and (g.name=='stone-furnace' or e.direction==g.dir) then k=k+1 break end
  end
end
return k/#B.ghosts
score.note: same, also requiring the right direction for inserters and belts

score.lua: local B=storage.bench local k=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=B.area,name='assembling-machine-1'}) do if e.status~=defines.entity_status.no_power then k=k+1 end end return k
